pretreatments.description: Mechanical degradation: milling substrates into chips of <2 cm and screening to achieve powder with particle size between 295 and 833 µm (20 and 80 mesh No.)
Concentrated phosphoric acid treatment: mixing substrate with 83-85.9% phosphoric acid at 50 °C for 50 min, followed by addition of cold acetone
Organosolv treatment: mixing substrate with 75% v/v ethanol solution (solid to liquid ratio 1:8) and 1% w/w sulfuric acid catalyst at 150 °C for 30 min
Thermal treatment: heating substrates to 150 °C (organosolv) or 140 °C (dilute acid)
Dilute sulfuric acid treatment: mixing substrate with 0.5% w/w sulfuric acid (solid to liquid ratio 1:10) at 140 °C for 5 min
Soxhlet extraction: two-step extraction used on untreated samples to remove water-soluble and ethanol-soluble substances
